assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the approved game HUD concept. Produce a production transparent HUD CHASSIS from this design, isolated with no dungeon backdrop. Preserve the gold dragon ornament left, round health housing, integrated upper-left stamina channel and six square sockets connected seamlessly to the right of the health orb. Main housing ONLY, exclude the separate green block circle entirely. Remove all icons, red liquid, blue fill, text, numbers and mouse icons. Health circle center and each of six sockets should be flat opaque near-black enamel empty recesses; the narrow upper-left stamina crescent should be an EMPTY dark channel with polished narrow gold inner and outer rims. Its arc must flow BEHIND the orb's left dragon ornament and terminate at the upper-right lightning mount, an empty small circle. Lower rail runs directly along bottom edges of the six square sockets, not a tall empty strip below. Six empty black gold-bordered keycap plaques overlap the lower rail, centered under each socket. Cohesive single continuous connected piece, no seams or cut joins. Strictly match original reference's visual quality: aged gold beveled highlights, deep emerald diamond accents, textured black iron. Entire silhouette fully visible, centered and as wide as possible in a landscape transparent canvas, minimal margins. No lettering, no symbols, no block circle, no map circle, no backgrounds, genuine alpha outside silhouette. Transparent outside only, opaque dark empty recesses within.
